correctness.rationale: Descendant sets D₂(x) of all 128 binary length-seven words are completely determined by 21 deleted coordinate pairs; deleting two equals retaining five. Independently rebuilt the pairwise-disjoint-descendant compatibility graph with 2955 edges and independently exhaustively enumerated exactly 476 increasing-order five-cliques while proving no six-clique exists (an exact backtracking search across every possible branch). For all 476 maxima independently recomputed group action of reversal and bit complement, obtaining 115 four-element and 8 two-element orbits (123 total), 94 avoiding both constant words, no universal word, and the stated 13-bin 17–30 output-coverage histogram with exactly six top-coverage codes in orbits of sizes two and four. Finite proof is exhaustive for specified n=7, deletion count=2, and explicit group only.
